name: Hamhock
summary: Hamhock is a massive two-headed ogre confined within the depths of the Stormwind Stockade. Locked away beneath the capital alongside hardened Defias insurgents and cutthroats, he looms as a particularly brutal and unexpected inmate amidst the prison riot.

sections.title: A Brute Behind Bars
sections.body: The Stormwind Stockade was built to hold petty thieves, murderers, and political dissidents, making a towering two-headed ogre an imposing sight among the cells. When the prisoners rose up and took control of the facility, Hamhock remained entrenched in the chaos, crushing anyone foolish enough to intrude on his cellblock.

sections.title: Murky Origins
sections.body: No record explains how Hamhock was captured or why a two-headed ogre was locked away among Stormwind's thieves and dissidents. Whatever brought him to the Stockade, he is now one of its most dangerous inmates.

aliases: who is the ogre in stockade
faq.answer: Hamhock is an elite two-headed ogre prisoner held within the Stormwind Stockade. Amid the uprising led by the Defias convicts, he acts as a dangerous obstacle deep inside the prison corridors.

faq.q: How did an ogre end up in the Stormwind Stockade?
aliases: why is there an ogre in stockades
faq.answer: No record explains how he was captured or brought to Stormwind.

faq.q: Is Hamhock allied with the Defias rioters?
faq.answer: While the entire facility has fallen into rebellion under Defias ringleaders, it is unclear whether Hamhock truly coordinates with them or simply revels in the unbridled mayhem of the broken cells.

faq.q: Is Hamhock related to the ogres in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Nothing ties him to them. The Splinter Fist ogres of Duskwood's Vul'Gol Ogre Mound are the nearest ogre clan to Stormwind, but no record says where Hamhock came from.

faq.q: Is Hamhock tied to any specific bounty or quest?
aliases: is there a quest for hamhock
faq.answer: No official bounties or city warrants are offered specifically for Hamhock's head. He is an incidental menace whom adventurers encounter while clearing out the rioting stronghold.

Two-headed ogres possess distinct personalities between their heads and are often more cunning or magically adept than their single-headed kin, making Hamhock exceptionally dangerous to standard prison guards.

angles.text: Finding a two-headed ogre unrestrained directly beneath the capital's streets underscores just how catastrophically the city guards have lost control of the Stockade.
Subduing Hamhock requires meeting raw, hulking strength head-on within the tight confines of the prison hallways.
